Every bend makes wire harder. Bend the s: Kowane lanƙwasa yana ƙara wa waya ƙarfi. Lanƙwasa wuri ɗaya sau da yawa kuma yana ɗauka, don haka ku yi kowane lanƙwasa sau ɗaya.
Wrapped loops for anything pulled. Simpl: Madaukai nannade don duk abin da aka ja. Sauƙaƙe madaukai don 'yan kunne.
Leave 4 to 5 cm of wire above the bead: Bar 4 zuwa 5 cm na waya sama da dutsen dutsen
Grip 3 mm above the bead and bend 90 deg: Rike 3 mm sama da dutsen dutsen kuma lanƙwasa digiri 90
Wrap over round nose pliers to form the: Kunna filayen hanci zagaye don samar da madauki
Add the next part now, if joining: Ƙara kashi na gaba yanzu, idan kun shiga
Wrap the tail 2 or 3 times, coils touchi: Kunna wutsiya sau 2 ko 3, coils suna taɓawa
Trim flush and press the end in: Gyara ruwa kuma latsa ƙarshen ciki
Step one. Leave about 4 to 5 cm of wire: Mataki na daya. Bar kusan 4 zuwa 5 cm na waya sama da katako.
Step two. Grip the wire with chain nose: Mataki na biyu. Rike wayar tare da filayen sarkar hanci kamar 3 mm sama da dutsen dutsen kuma lanƙwasa ta digiri 90. Wannan tazarar mm 3 ita ce inda kayan ku za su zauna.
Step three. Place round nose pliers at t: Mataki na uku. Sanya maƙallan hanci zagaye a lanƙwasa kuma ku nannade waya a saman muƙamuƙi da ƙasa kewaye da muƙamuƙi na ƙasa don yin madauki. Yi alama a kan muƙamuƙi don haka kowane madauki daidai yake da girmansa.
Step four. If you are joining to another: Mataki na hudu. Idan kuna shiga wani bangare, zame shi a yanzu.
Step five. Hold the loop flat and wrap t: Mataki na biyar. Rike madauki a kwance kuma kunsa wutsiya a kusa da kara sau 2 ko 3, coils suna taɓawa.
Step six. Trim the tail flush and press: Mataki na shida. Gyara wutsiya kuma a danna ƙarshen don kada wani abu ya tsaya.
Simple loops are quick and can be opened: Sauƙaƙe madaukai suna da sauri kuma ana iya buɗe su, don haka sun dace da 'yan kunne. Madauki nannade ba zai iya buɗewa ba, don haka yi amfani da shi don mundaye da abin wuya.
Hold with two chain nose pliers: Rike da sarkar hanci guda biyu
Pull the ends apart into a C: Ja da iyakar zuwa cikin C
To open a jump ring, hold it with two ch: Don buɗe zoben tsalle, riƙe shi da sarƙan hancin sarƙoƙi biyu kuma karkatar da iyakar gefe, hannu ɗaya daga gare ku, ɗaya zuwa gare ku. Juya jujjuyawar don rufe shi ba tare da tazara ba.
Never pull the ends apart into a C shape: Kada a taɓa raba iyakar zuwa siffar C. Yana raunana zoben, kuma ba zai sake rufewa da kyau ba.
Here is a worked example. Esther in Ibad: Ga misalin aiki. Esther a Ibadan tana haɗuwa da ƙwanƙolin dutse 8 mm tare da madaukai nannade, ga abokin ciniki wanda wuyansa ya kai cm 16.
She adds 2 cm of ease, so the finished l: Ta ƙara 2 cm cikin sauƙi, don haka tsayin da aka gama shine 18 cm.
The clasp, jump ring and end loop take a: Matsewa, zoben tsalle da madauki na ƙarshe suna ɗaukar kusan 2 cm, don haka sashin da aka haɗa dole ne ya zama cm 16.
She makes one test link and measures it:: Ta yi hanyar haɗin gwaji guda ɗaya kuma ta auna shi: 1.6 cm daga ƙarshen madauki zuwa ƙarshen madauki.
16 divided by 1.6 gives 10 links. She cu: 16 ya raba ta 1.6 yana ba da mahaɗa 10. Ta yanke 10 cm na ma'auni 22 a kowace mahaɗin, kuma munduwa yana da 18 cm, kamar yadda aka tsara. Koyaushe auna hanyar haɗin gwaji guda ɗaya kafin ku lissafta.
Linked section, minus clasp: 16 cm: Sashin da aka haɗe, raƙuman matsi: 16 cm
Push coils tight with your thumbnail: Tura coils tare da ɗan yatsa
Make spirals in matching pairs: Yi karkace a cikin nau'i-nau'i masu dacewa
Kink in fine wire? Unwrap and restart: Kink in fine waya? Cire kundi kuma sake farawa
Coils use a lot of fine wire, so measure: Coils suna amfani da waya mai kyau da yawa, don haka auna farko. Misali, Aisha a Kano ta nade waya 50 cm sannan ta samu 4.5 cm na nada: kusan 11.1 cm na waya cikin santimita.
Keep the thin wire at a right angle to t: Ajiye siririyar waya a kusurwar dama zuwa ainihin, kuma a tura coils tare kowane ƴan juyi don kada wani gibi ya nuna.
For flat spirals, let your thumb do the: Don lebur mai lebur, bari babban yatsan ku ya yi lankwasawa, ba maɗaukaki ba. Don 'yan kunne, yi duka karkace kafin wani abu.
In woven wire, the thin wire goes over t: A cikin waya da aka saƙa, siriyar waya ta wuce saman firam ɗin waya, ƙasa tsakanin, kewaye da wayar ƙasa da baya sama. Ƙididdige wucewar don haka duka bangarorin biyu su dace.
The common mistake is straightening a ki: Kuskuren gama gari shine daidaita kink akai-akai. Zai kama daga baya a hannun abokin ciniki. Cire baya zuwa gaban kink kuma ci gaba da sabon yanki.
